benefits.title: Why Is It Hard to Resist?
benefits.description: We combine hypoallergenic medical materials with state-of-the-art mechanical engineering to deliver a flawless visual and tactile experience.
benefits.benefit1Description: The built-in warming system brings the companion up to the natural body temperature of 37°C in minutes. Experience incredibly realistic, warm embraces.
benefits.benefit2Description: We exclusively use surgical-grade TPE silicone, powdered and velvet-finished, replicating the elasticity and softness of human skin without any stickiness or synthetic odor.
benefits.benefit3Description: Articulated framework made of lightweight titanium and aluminum alloy. Allows seamless posing, perfectly recreating human biomechanics with extreme precision.

hygiene.title: 100% Guaranteed Medical Hygiene Protocol
hygiene.description: For rentals, your safety is our absolute commitment. After every single session, each companion undergoes a rigorous 5-stage clinical sterilization procedure using medical-grade broad-spectrum sanitizers followed by deep UV-C light sanitation. You receive a perfectly sterile, vacuum-sealed companion.

faq.title: Answers to Your Questions
faq.q1: How does the package look upon delivery?
faq.a1: Your package is delivered in an opaque, robust, and completely plain cardboard box with no company names, logos, or revealing text. No one (not even the courier) will know what lies inside.
faq.q2: How is hygiene guaranteed for rentals?
faq.a2: All components are subjected to a rigorous 5-step clinical sanitization using specialized medical products, inside and out, finished with 15 minutes of intensive UV-C sterilization. Safety is our guarantee.
faq.q3: Can I fully customize a doll for purchase?
faq.a3: Absolutely! For permanent purchases, you can personalize facial models, makeup, hair length, eye color, skin tone, breast consistency, warming modes, and interactive AI sensors.
